The Alignment Research Center is a nonprofit research organization founded in 2021 and headquartered in Berkeley, California, United States. On its website the organization describes its mission as aligning future machine learning systems with human interests. It states that it expects new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities, and that as AI progress accelerates it may become increasingly difficult to adapt quickly enough to keep up with the changing technology. The organization says methods that can be safely scaled over many orders of magnitude would leave it better prepared, in the same way that generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up dramatically over the last decade.

The material does not list any specific AI products from the company. Its stated focus is research rather than shipped tools, and no products are recorded for it.

The company's recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 282. No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it.
